name: Scarlet Commander Mograine
summary: Within the Scarlet Monastery, Scarlet Commander Mograine guards the Cathedral with the Scarlet Crusade. A zealous paladin, he faces efforts by the Horde and Alliance to disrupt the Crusade's threat to Tirisfal Glades and the lands around it.

sections.title: Defender of the Chapel
sections.body: At the heart of the Scarlet Monastery, Scarlet Commander Mograine leads the Scarlet Crusade garrison in the Crusader's Chapel. A devoted paladin, he strikes with holy power and shields himself. Those the Crusade judges corrupted or unclean meet his stunning blows.

sections.title: A Miraculous Bond
sections.body: High Inquisitor Whitemane fights beside Mograine in the chapel. When an attacking force brings him down, Whitemane comes from the rear sanctum. She incapacitates the intruders with the Holy Light and restores Mograine from death. Their attackers must then face both commanders at once.

faq.q: Where can Scarlet Commander Mograine be found?
faq.answer: Scarlet Commander Mograine waits before the altar in the Crusader's Chapel, inside the Cathedral wing of the Scarlet Monastery in northeastern Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: What is Mograine's role in the Scarlet Crusade?
faq.answer: Mograine commands the Scarlet Crusade forces garrisoned at the Monastery. He leads its paladins and soldiers alongside High Inquisitor Whitemane.
Mograine fights at close range as a paladin. He stuns opponents with Hammer of Justice and strikes with Crusader Strikes. Retribution Aura protects him, and he uses Divine Shield when pressed.

faq.q: Why does High Inquisitor Whitemane revive him?
faq.answer: High Inquisitor Whitemane revives Mograine because they share a close bond and lead the Monastery together. When he falls, she puts their attackers to sleep with magic and raises him to full strength.

faq.q: Why are the Alliance and Horde fighting him?
aliases: in the name of the light
faq.answer: The Scarlet Crusade sees outsiders, living or undead, as carriers of corruption. The Alliance and the Forsaken send champions against the Cathedral to kill its leaders and weaken the Crusade's fanatical presence in Lordaeron.

faq.q: Does Mograine heal himself during the encounter?
faq.answer: Yes. When pressed, Mograine can use Lay on Hands to restore himself to full health. High Inquisitor Whitemane also brings healing when she joins the battle.

angles.text: Mograine shows how a paladin's vows of protection and righteousness can be twisted into ruthless zealotry.
For the Forsaken, Commander Mograine is the Scarlet Crusade's sharpest blade. His forces are near the Undercity and threaten Forsaken survival in Tirisfal.
The Scarlet Crusade once shared common ground with the Alliance. Leaders in Southshore and Stormwind now see commanders like Mograine as fallen into violent madness.
